summary: In the controller task pod run `awx-manage list_instances` and `awx-manage deprovision_instance --hostname=<node>` for old nodes, keeping only `aap-controller-task`; `oc delete secret/aap-resource-server` to regenerate resource keys; and POST `{"verify_checksums": true}` to `/api/galaxy/pulp/api/v3/repair/` to repair hub data.
questions: How do I remove old nodes after migrating to OpenShift?
Repair automation hub on OpenShift after migration

answer_card.title: Finish the OpenShift import
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc exec -it $AAP_CONTROLLER_POD -- /bin/bash
awx-manage list_instances
awx-manage deprovision_instance --hostname=node1.example.org
exit
oc delete secret/aap-resource-server
curl -d '{"verify_checksums": true }' -X POST -k https://<aap url>/api/galaxy/pulp/api/v3/repair/ \
  -u <admin_user>:<restored_admin_password>
```
